lines.text: After three quiet years, Jehoshaphat visits Ahab, who asks him to fight Aram for Ramoth-gilead.
Four hundred prophets say go up, but Ahab hates Micaiah son of Imlah because he never prophesies good.
Zedekiah makes iron horns and says the LORD will use them to gore the Philistines.
Micaiah says the LORD sent a lying spirit into the mouths of all Ahab's soldiers.
Zedekiah strikes Micaiah, and Ahab orders him put in prison with only bread and water until he returns safely.
